Plot a continuous track on its scalogram

Source: R/track_hmm.R
plot_track.Rd

Plots the scalogram with the track(s) of track_ridge_hmm or track_astro_hmm and their credible bands, the confidence of the track and, when available, the sedimentation rate and the age model with its uncertainty.

Usage

plot_track(
  track,
  wavelet,
  show = NULL,
  flags = NULL,
  palette = "viridis",
  keep_editable = FALSE,
  scale = "auto"
)

Arguments

track

The track to draw (data frame of class wr_track): the output of track_ridge_hmm, track_astro_hmm or track_chirp_hmm (for track_astro_auto pass its element track). Required, no default.

wavelet

The scalogram the track was made from, or another one on the same depth axis to display (list of class analyze.wavelet, e.g. the element scalogram of track_astro_auto). Required, no default.

show

Periods (in time units, numeric vector, e.g. c(405, 41, 23.7)) of the astronomical cycles whose depth periods are drawn for a sedimentation-rate track; each is matched within 10 percent to the periods stored in the track (attribute astro_periods). For a track without stored periods (e.g. from track_chirp_hmm) the given periods are drawn as they are. NULL draws all stored periods (or the tracked period of a track_ridge_hmm result). Default=NULL.

flags

Optional intervals to shade in all panels: a data frame with the columns from and to (depths), e.g. the element flags of track_astro_auto, or TRUE to use the attribute flags of track; anything else draws no shading. Default=NULL.

palette

Name of a hcl.colors palette for the colour scale, a character string, for example "viridis", "Plasma", "Inferno", "YlOrRd", "Spectral", "Blue-Red", "Zissou 1"; run grDevices::hcl.pals() to list all 115 names. Low values get the first colour of the palette. Names of the viridis family ("viridis", "magma", "inferno", "plasma", "cividis", "rocket", "mako", "turbo") give the colours of the viridis package, as in the wavelet plots. Default="viridis".

keep_editable

Keep the graphical parameters (par) and the panel layout after plotting, so that more elements can be added to the last panel (logical, TRUE or FALSE); FALSE restores the previous settings. Default=FALSE.

scale

Colour scale of the scalogram, as in all image plots of the package (see plot_wavelet), one of "auto", "log", "quantile", "sqrt", "linear". "auto" uses a log scale for synchrosqueezed (mostly empty) maps and quantiles otherwise; the power of a non-synchrosqueezed scalogram is first divided by its mean per period. Default="auto".

Value

Invisibly the track.
